title: TrustGraph: PROV-O Dual Named Graph Isolation & 5-Stage Query Explainability Traces
summary: TrustGraph separates extraction lineage from runtime query explainability using dual named graphs and distinct URI schemes. Document/extraction triples use https://trustgraph.ai/... URIs inside urn:graph:source via set_graph() and document_triples(), whereas query-time PROV-O explainability uses urn:trustgraph:... URIs (urn:trustgraph:question:{id} and urn:trustgraph:prov:{stage}:{id} across question, grounding, exploration, focus, and synthesis) inside urn:graph:retrieval alongside _append_token_triples().
